prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production enemy sprite for Depths, a dark stressful first-person pixel dungeon crawler. Flat sparse surfaces, no individual fur, veins smaller than a large readable mark, no pores/grain/noise, no gradients/dithering/antialiasing, no glossy rendering, no ground shadow, background or text. Serious and unsettling, not cute/cartoon. Front-facing full-body transparent square canvas; keep all anatomy/equipment inside with generous 10% margins. Designed to reduce to a native128x128 sprite with max32 shared colours, bottom-centre scene origin (64,120). No scenery or UI. Dangerous venom-spider kin of the cave spider in the reference: preserve two broad body masses, exactly eight angular jointed leg silhouettes and low forward stance. Change material to sickly dark green-black with a few restrained olive warning patches and two bright pale-green fangs. No hair strands, extra limbs or luminous aura. Idle front-facing slightly elevated so legs read; threatening silhouette, simple clustered forms. Reference spider is direct family/proportions/style reference; retain exactly four legs on each side.
